en: Proverbs 4

p.src: 1  Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

en: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
u.src: 1  Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

p.src: 2  for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

en: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
u.src: 2  for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

p.src: 3  For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

en: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
u.src: 3  For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

p.src: 4  He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

en: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
u.src: 4  He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

p.src: 5  Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

en: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
u.src: 5  Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

p.src: 6  Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

en: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
u.src: 6  Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

p.src: 7  Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

en: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
u.src: 7  Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

p.src: 8  Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

en: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
u.src: 8  Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

p.src: 9  She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

en: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
u.src: 9  She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

p.src: 10  Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

en: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
u.src: 10  Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

p.src: 11  I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

en: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
u.src: 11  I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

p.src: 12  When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

en: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
u.src: 12  When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

p.src: 13  Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

en: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
u.src: 13  Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

p.src: 14  Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

en: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
u.src: 14  Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

p.src: 15  Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

en: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
u.src: 15  Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

p.src: 16  For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

en: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
u.src: 16  For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

p.src: 17  For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

en: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
u.src: 17  For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

p.src: 18  But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

en: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
u.src: 18  But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

p.src: 19  The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

en: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
u.src: 19  The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

p.src: 20  My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

en: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
u.src: 20  My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

p.src: 21  Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

en: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
u.src: 21  Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

p.src: 22  For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

en: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
u.src: 22  For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

p.src: 23  Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

en: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
u.src: 23  Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

p.src: 24  Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

en: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
u.src: 24  Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

p.src: 25  Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

en: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
u.src: 25  Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

p.src: 26  Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

en: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
u.src: 26  Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

p.src: 27  Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

en: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
u.src: 27  Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
